description: This file defines a custom ImageView subclass called FixedAspectRatioImageView that maintains a fixed aspect ratio based on layout attributes or programmatic setting. It overrides measurement to keep the aspect ratio consistent during layout.

classes.name: FixedAspectRatioImageView
classes.description: A custom ImageView that maintains a fixed aspect ratio during layout changes, based on attributes or programmatic settings.

methods.name: FixedAspectRatioImageView
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the view and reads the aspect ratio attribute from XML.

methods.name: setAspectRatio
methods.description: Sets the aspect ratio programmatically and requests a layout update if changed.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Overridden method that calculates the view's width and height to maintain the specified aspect ratio based on measurement modes.
